entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-06-02
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Microsoft.DotNet.Watch.UnitTests.FileWatcherTests.DeleteSubfolder has flaky test assertion #49233
  • Should conflict resolution lift the versions read from PackageOverrides.txt #49232
  • SDK doesn't evaluate the global.json constraints for a project #49231
  • Remove usage of Alpine 3.18 Helix image #49229
  • dotnet CLI: Enhancements Epic #49225

Closed

  • dotnet run file custom entrypoint support #49151
  • How to debug a file-based app #49224
  • Duplicate "System.Reflection.Assembly...Attribute" CS0579 #49002
  • How to get its path in app.cs when using `dotnet run app.cs` #49223

PullRequests

Merged

  • Remove dead props #49227
    Area-CodeFlow
  • [StaticWebAsset] Exclude source maps from updating fingerprinted blazor.js #49178
    Area-AspNetCore, 10.0.1xx

Updated

  • stop using System.CommandLine types that aren't public anymore #49181
    Area-CLI
  • [Experiment] Add ability to manage Local SDKs in the SDK #49209
    Area-Infrastructure
  • `dotnet tool install --local` works by default, by creating a manifest by default, utilizing `--create-manifest-if-needed` #48906
    Bug, Review for breaking changes, tool, breaking-change, needs-breaking-change-doc-created, Tab Completion
  • Adjust `IsTestProject` hacks to not include MTP #49085
  • Add support for `dotnet file.cs` (without explicit `run` subcommand) #48387
    untriaged, Area-run-file
  • Update maintenance-packages pruning versions #49092
  • dotnet cli run referencing local libraries in addition to referencing… #49216
  • [release/10.0.1xx-preview5] Fix minimum width of Author column in tabular output #49169
  • Show ansi colors in azdo and gh actions CI #49014
  • Exclude upstream files from Emscripten and code coverage #49186
    Area-Infrastructure
  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #49080
    Area-CodeFlow, Area-Roslyn
